additionalDocuments.label: The Watercrest original Ellington amenity plans, hosted by Mitchell’s

review.gallery: Twelve project-specific renders from the direct Ellington brochure and one dated October 2026 earthworks photograph. The Riverine render leads the card because the progress photograph shows site preparation without a recognisable house.
review.location: The original developer map and fifteen values come from brochure p9, including The Sanctuary Villas at 3 minutes. The floor-plan inset labels Al Abjar Street. Dubainary and JRE publish the same approximate point. Oplus and PropRealm publish different points, so no gate-level accuracy is claimed.
review.floorPlans: Fourteen complete sheets: nine home level drawings, two site plans and three amenity plans. The Alcove ground sheet retains the paired kitchen options. All three totals were verified visually and are labelled as printed home areas, separate from plot and registered transaction areas.

unavailable: Verified community entrance coordinates, completed villa photographs and live travel times.
